title: JP Morgan to add Philippines and Saudi Arabia to key EM bond index over 10 months
description: JP Morgan has announced plans to include Saudi Arabia and the Philippines in its emerging market debt index starting in 2027. The Saudi riyal-denominated sukuk and Philippine peso-denominated government bonds will be integrated over a ten-month period. The index is expected to adjust the maximum country weight limit from 10% to 9%. Saudi Arabia's weight will reach 2.71%, while the Philippines will have a weight of 1.64%.

title: The average US 30-year mortgage rate falls to 7.18% this week, its third straight decline
description: The average long-term mortgage rates in the U.S. decreased for the third consecutive week, offering some respite. The average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage declined to 7.18% from 7.24%, according to Freddie Mac. Additionally, the 15-year fixed-rate mortgages saw a drop to 6.57%, slightly down from last week. These lower rates help to alleviate the financial burden on prospective homebuyers facing increased costs.

title: US yields fall in choppy session as oil rises and equities sink

Investors are reassessing their outlook on the US-Iran relations following new election results. The labor market remains resilient with dropping unemployment claims and heightened productivity levels, pointing towards ongoing inflation risk.

title: Paras Healthcare posts Rs 40 crore Q2 net profit in first results after listing

This performance shows a significant increase from the net profit of Rs 12.38 crore reported last year. Revenue from operations reached Rs 510.89 crore, with expenses at Rs 463.12 crore during the same period. The company utilized a portion of its IPO proceeds to strengthen its balance sheet.

title: Godfrey Phillips Q2 profit down 37% to Rs 190 cr; revenue up twofold at Rs 4,198 cr
description: Godfrey Phillips India Ltd reported a significant 37.73 percent decrease in net profit for the September quarter, primarily driven by a substantial tax increase from the previous fiscal year. Despite this, the company's total consolidated income surged to Rs 8,139.64 crore during the first half of FY27.
